publicDelivery: These examples use standard installed components/ui and components block destinations. They contain no site helper imports or undeclared external assets. Use the authoritative complete registry payload for each item, not its main TSX file only.

runtimeAssertions.alert-dialog: Delete world opens named alertdialog; Yes increments once, explicitly closes and returns trigger focus.
runtimeAssertions.command-palette: Open command palette; choose Save world; output save, dialog closes and trigger regains focus. CommandDialog owns its Command root.
runtimeAssertions.data-table-features: Page1/2 → Next → Page2/2; filter Grasslands resets visible rows; select row; filter missing world → No results. Engine is TanStack9/useTable/table.FlexRender. Install data-table-features.ts as well as block TSX.
runtimeAssertions.date-picker: Pick a day → October15,2026; trigger formats October15th,2026; installed block remains open until Escape. No hidden input/name or auto-close contract. Range is the actual two-month installed block.
runtimeAssertions.message-scroller: 12 stable append-only messageIds; First → scrollTop0; send Bring torches →13 messages; Latest → end gap<2. Provider wraps useMessageScroller; explicit bounded Viewport; rolelog/aria-live chosen by example.
runtimeAssertions.tooltip: Actual keyboard path Preview → tabpanel → Inspect trigger. Focus shows data-slot tooltip-content; Escape removes it. Existing Popup has no roletooltip or automatic aria-describedby connection; do not assume those semantics.
runtimeAssertions.avatar: Packaged wide/steve and slim/alex, hat=true,16logical atscale2. Both exact native faces0/2048 total; grouping/count are web adaptation.
runtimeAssertions.chart: Use #17 maintained actual Recharts3 modules and installed helpers. Container config/colors, packaged text/GPU resources, responsive runtime and frame/profiler data must resolve in external consumer.
